title: Nickel-Metformin Ternary Complexes: Geometrical, Thermal, DNA Binding, and Molecular Docking Studies.
authors: Rajeshwari, K; Vasantha, P; Kumar, B Sathish; Lakshmi, P V Anantha
one_liner_zh: 该文研究镍-二甲双胍三元配合物的合成、DNA结合及分子对接，虽涉及小分子-DNA互作和对接，但对象为金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、对接简单，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Novel three nickel(II) complexes of type [Ni(metf)(o-phen)(2)]Cl(2) (1), [Ni(metf)(opda)(2)]Cl(2) (2), [Ni(metf)(2-2'bipy)(2)]Cl(2) (3), (Metf = metformin, o-phen = ortho-phenanthroline, opda = ortho-phenylenediamine, 2-2' bipy = 2-2' bipyridyl) were synthesized and characterized by various analytical and spectral techniques. Based on these studies, octahedral geometry is assigned to these complexes. The DNA binding properties of these complexes were investigated by absorption, emission, and viscosity studies. From the spectral data, it was concluded that the complexes bind to DNA through groove mode of binding. The intrinsic binding constants (K(b)) from absorption spectroscopy were 1.60 x 10(4), 3.57 x 10(4), and 5.70 x 10(4) M(-1) for 1, 2, and 3, respectively, and Stern-Volmer quenching constants (K(sv)) from emission spectroscopy were 0.11, 0.87, and 0.24, respectively. Thermal degradation pattern of the compounds was studied and Coats-Redfern method is used to determine kinetic parameters for complexes 1, 2, and 3 from thermal studies. The software Discovery Studio 2.1 was used to assess the binding affinity and interaction pattern of complexes with the B-DNA receptor protein and complex 1 has the highest dock score.
abstract_zh: 合成了三种新型镍(II)配合物，类型为[Ni(metf)(o-phen)₂]Cl₂ (1)、[Ni(metf)(opda)₂]Cl₂ (2)、[Ni(metf)(2-2'bipy)₂]Cl₂ (3)（其中Metf = 二甲双胍 (metformin)，o-phen = 邻菲咯啉 (ortho-phenanthroline)，opda = 邻苯二胺 (ortho-phenylenediamine)，2-2' bipy = 2-2'联吡啶 (2-2' bipyridyl)），并通过多种分析和光谱技术对其进行了表征。基于这些研究，这些配合物被赋予八面体几何构型。通过吸收、发射和粘度研究考察了这些配合物的DNA结合性质。从光谱数据得出结论，这些配合物通过沟槽结合模式与DNA结合。吸收光谱测得的内在结合常数（K(b)）分别为1.60 × 10⁴、3.57 × 10⁴和5.70 × 10⁴ M⁻¹，对应配合物1、2和3；发射光谱测得的Stern-Volmer淬灭常数（K(sv)）分别为0.11、0.87和0.24。研究了化合物的热降解模式，并使用Coats-Redfern方法从热研究确定配合物1、2和3的动力学参数。使用软件Discovery Studio 2.1评估配合物与B-DNA受体蛋白的结合亲和力和相互作用模式，其中配合物1具有最高的对接得分。
